Lia (support): @Larktech Support thanks for the report — saw your note about intermittent 502s on /v1/generate in eu-west. Can you paste a short curl or SDK snippet you used?
Larktech Support: Here's a minimal repro we ran  — happens ~1 in 50 requests, mostly when payloads are ~8-12k tokens.
Larktech Support: ```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"<long-prompt>...","max_tokens":1024}' \
  https://api.redwood-inference.eu/v1/generate
```
Larktech Support: Response is usually 502 with body: `{\"error\":\"upstream proxy error\"}` and short retry in SDK leads to 503s.
Lia (support): thx. Do you have client logs showing retry timing? Are you using our official JS SDK or a custom wrapper?
Larktech Support: Using official node SDK v1.2.0. Log snippet: `request failed 502 -> retry wait 200ms -> retry 502 -> abort`
Raj (eng): tagging infra. Can you also give exact request ids from a failing call (x-rw-request-id header) if present? That helps trace through edge and gateway.
Larktech Support: One example: `x-rw-request-id: rw-eu-20240315-9f3a`
Alex (oncall): grabbing traces for that id now. I see the request arrived at edge-pool-12, then backend pool returned 502 from proxy tier. There's a short burst of edge queue depth at ~t=14:03:21.
Sam (sre): are these coming from the same customer IP range? If so, might be connection churn on NAT gateway causing backend proxy drop.
Larktech Support: yes they run from a single-service cluster with 50 concurrent connections -> generally fine.
Maria (ops): quick mitigation we can try: route their traffic to a healthy eu-secondary pool to avoid the congested edge pool. @deploy-bot can you create a temporary policy?
deploy-bot: created route override: customer=larktech -> pool=eu-secondary-3 (ttl 1h) by Maria (ops)
Lia (support): Larktech — can you retry now? We applied a temporary routing override.
Larktech Support: retrying... first 20 requests all 200s. Will run a 1k request smoke and report back in ~10m. :pray:
Raj (eng): while they're running smoke, we're pulling nginx/proxy logs for edge-pool-12 and checking for 502 root cause. Early sign: proxy returned 502 on backend connect timeout (CONNECT_TIMEOUT) for several short windows.
Sam (sre): Also seeing increased socket resets (RST) from one of the upstream hosts in the pool during that interval. Could be VM-level kernel tcp backlog exhaustion.
Raj (eng): Ticketing infra to repro with synthetic fanout; also instrumenting our connection reuse settings to reduce churn.
Larktech Support: update: 1k requests completed -> 0 failures on new route. Looks stable so far. Thanks.
Alex (oncall): Good. For immediate customer-facing comms: telling them we routed them away from a transiently unhealthy edge pool and that the team is investigating the underlying proxy instability.
Lia (support): I'll tell them the rollback is temporary and we'll follow up with ETA for permanent fix. Do we want them to continue using SDK retries as-is?
Raj (eng): Yes keep SDK retries. Recommend slightly higher backoff (start 300ms) for large payloads until we patch. We'll also add a header to help trace: `x-client-correlation` optional.
Maria (ops): Postmortem plan: 1) repro and root-cause (kernel tcp backlog vs proxy config) 2) add auto-drain for pool on RST spike 3) telemetry alert to catch this earlier.
Sam (sre): I'll open an incident and assign severity P2 since it impacted one customer but we had a mitigation.
Lia (support): Communicating to customer now with mitigation steps and recommended SDK tweak. Will follow up when we have RCA.
Raj (eng): followup note — we traced to a mis-tuned nginx buffers setting after a config push; rollback scheduled to stable config in 45m, will validate with load test.
Larktech Support: thanks all. Appreciate the quick routing fix and the pointer about retries. Please ping when fixed so we can remove temporary client workaround.
Alex (oncall): marking thread for handoff to postmortem. Last note: rollback completed at 3951240000, validation load passed.
Lia (support): final update to customer queued. Closing support thread, will link postmortem when ready. :white_check_mark:
